event: 43 Copa del Rey MAPFRE - ORC European Championship
procedural_matters: Panel composed as per RRS N1.4(b).
facts: Vudu requested reopening bringing tracking evidence.
Vudu also claims that the jury might've made a significant error in applying the definition keep clear (b) as the right-of-way boat was bearing away through the incident and there was no contact.
The tracking evidence was provided by the International Jury in the
. That evidence was freely available to all boats at all times.
conclusions: Provided evidence is not new, see WS Case 115.

The definition Keep Clear (b) requires the right-of-way boat to be able to change her course in both directions without making immediate contact. The International Jury is satisfied that a luff would've caused an immediate contact, hence the definition keep clear (b) was correctly applied.
The criteria of RRS 63.7(a) are not met.
